title: Estate income tax return - Form 1041 basics
facts: An estate can have a federal income-tax filing obligation on Form 1041 when it meets applicable filing thresholds or circumstances.
Estate income tax is different from federal estate tax: Form 1041 generally concerns income earned by the estate after death, while estate tax concerns transfers of wealth under separate rules.
Income distributed to beneficiaries can carry tax reporting consequences through Schedule K-1 under applicable rules.
The executor or fiduciary should distinguish income earned before death, estate income after death and income distributed to beneficiaries.
